not_modelled: cash earns 0% although TL deposits paid far more; idle cash is penalised
P/B uses CURRENT nominal capital, so a rights issue inside the window is not captured
returns are nominal TL; inflation is not removed
one year, one path: no significance claim is made
p4_reproduction: 866/866 banded M3/Ek4/Ek9 values reproduced exactly from raw inputs

rules_frozen_before_first_run.benchmark: XU100 buy and hold, same start, same capital
rules_frozen_before_first_run.discontinuity_rule: any daily close move beyond +/-12% inside the window (BIST limit is +/-10%) marks an unadjusted corporate action; the ticker is removed before scoring
rules_frozen_before_first_run.execution_price: adj_close on execution day (total return incl. dividends)
rules_frozen_before_first_run.pb_very_good: P/B > 0 and percentile among positive-P/B cohort <= 1/3

variants.3_aylik: rebalance every 3rd month from the first
variants.6_aylik: rebalance every 6th month from the first
variants.serbest: monthly refresh: sell names that left top quarter or cheap third, buy AL+cheap into free slots; weekly (first trading day of each ISO week): sell a holding whose P/B left the cheapest third; freed cash waits for the next monthly refresh

rules_frozen_before_first_run.weighting: equal weight among holdings, fully invested; cash only if nothing qualifies
